name: Gravity Run
hook: One button flips gravity. First to the end wins.
how: Everyone runs on their own. Flip between the floor and the ceiling to dodge gaps, spikes and walls, hit speed pads, and reach the finish first. Fall off and you're sent back to the start of that stretch.
controls: Space, ↑ or click to flip gravity; on touch, tap anywhere or the Flip button
uses: The players who won the most races.
The host's browser runs the countdown, records who finishes and when, and starts the next race; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
Bots race you and fill the start line until enough people join.
Everyone runs the same course, with the other runners shown as see-through ghosts.
ideas: Add a portal that turns gravity sideways for a few seconds
Make the course an underwater cave with bubbles that slow you down
Add coins on the course and show who collected the most
